metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 1960 · The Apartment
metas.description: A Manhattan insurance clerk tries to rise in his company by letting its executives use his apartment for trysts, but office politics and his own romantic hopes complicate matters.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 1967 · The Graduate
metas.description: A disillusioned college graduate finds himself torn between his older lover and her daughter.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 1965 · Doctor Zhivago
metas.description: The life of a Russian physician and poet who, although married to another, falls in love with a political activist's wife and experiences hardship during World War I and then the October Revolution.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 1963 · Charade
metas.description: Romance and intrigue ensue in Paris as a woman is pursued by several men who want to get their hands on a fortune her murdered husband had stolen. She soon loses trust in those who claim they want to help her.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 1964 · The Umbrellas of Cherbourg
metas.description: A young woman separated from her lover by war faces a life-altering decision.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 1960 · L'Avventura
metas.description: A woman disappears during a Mediterranean boating trip. During the search, her lover and her best friend become attracted to each other.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1967 · Belle de Jour
metas.description: A frigid young housewife decides to spend her midweek afternoons as a prostitute.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1962 · Jules and Jim
metas.description: Decades of a love triangle concerning two friends and an impulsive woman.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1968 · Romeo and Juliet
metas.description: When two young members of feuding families meet, forbidden love ensues.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1961 · Last Year at Marienbad
metas.description: In a strange and isolated chateau, a man becomes acquainted with a woman and insists that they have met before.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1961 · Breakfast at Tiffany's
metas.description: A young New York socialite becomes interested in a young man who has moved into her apartment building, but her past threatens to get in the way.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1962 · Lolita
metas.description: A middle-aged college professor becomes infatuated with a 14-year-old girl.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1960 · The Time Machine
metas.description: A man's vision for a utopian society is disillusioned when travelling forward into time reveals a dark and dangerous society.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1966 · El Dorado
metas.description: Cole Thornton, a gunfighter for hire, joins forces with old friend, Sheriff J.P. Hara. Together with an old Indian fighter and a gambler, they help a rancher and his family fight a rival rancher who's trying to steal their water.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1966 · How to Steal a Million
metas.description: The daughter of an art forger teams up with a burglar to steal one of her father's forgeries and protect his secret.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 1968 · The Party
metas.description: A clerical mistake results in a bumbling Indian film star being invited to an exclusive Hollywood party instead of being fired.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 1965 · Pierrot le Fou
metas.description: Pierrot escapes his boring society and travels from Paris to the Mediterranean Sea with Marianne, a girl chased by hit-men from Algeria. They lead an unorthodox life, always on the run.

metas.name: ★ 7.4 · 1963 · Contempt
metas.description: A French writer's marriage deteriorates while working on Fritz Lang's version of "The Odyssey", as his wife accuses him of using her to court favor with the film's brash American producer.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 1961 · The Parent Trap
metas.description: Teenage twin sisters swap places and scheme to reunite their divorced parents.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 1961 · The Misfits
metas.description: A divorcée falls for an over-the-hill cowboy who is struggling to maintain his romantically independent lifestyle.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 1963 · The Pink Panther
